error_text: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon at unix:///var/run/docker.sock. Is the docker daemon running?
context: Every docker command fails to reach the daemon.
root_cause: The Docker daemon is not running (or the user cannot reach its socket).
fix: Start Docker Desktop / `sudo systemctl start docker`; on Linux, add your user to the `docker` group.
